name: opencode
install: (tmp=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT && git clone --depth 1 --branch v{version} https://github.com/Trevoke/{repo} "$tmp" && mkdir -p .opencode/skills .opencode/agents && find .opencode/skills -maxdepth 1 -name 'recs-*' -exec rm -rf {} + && rm -f .opencode/agents/recs-code-reviewer.md && cp -R "$tmp/skills" "$tmp/agents" .opencode/)
installUser: (tmp=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT && git clone --depth 1 --branch v{version} https://github.com/Trevoke/{repo} "$tmp" && mkdir -p ~/.config/opencode/skills ~/.config/opencode/agents && find ~/.config/opencode/skills -maxdepth 1 -name 'recs-*' -exec rm -rf {} + && rm -f ~/.config/opencode/agents/recs-code-reviewer.md && cp -R "$tmp/skills" "$tmp/agents" ~/.config/opencode/)
requirements: The package is written for opencode 2 (`@opencode/cli`). opencode 1 (`opencode-ai`) names its tools differently.
opencode keeps its own subagent depth limit, `experimental.subagent_depth`, which defaults to 1: by default a subagent cannot dispatch another.

memory.list: the memory file (`/tmp/recs-files-memory-<the project directory's name>.md`, a checklist)
memory.in-progress: in progress in the memory file
